subject: NL HR sync – vacation day expiry
location: Teams meeting › NL HR sync › 28 Sep 2026 10:00–10:30
transcript:
Sofie Janssens: Quick one on statutory vacation days in the Netherlands. Several Albert Heijn employees lost days on 1 July because nobody reminded them.
Jan Peeters: In Belgium we send a reminder in October, we could reuse that flow.
Sofie Janssens: Decision: from 2027 every Dutch client gets an automatic reminder on 1 April listing statutory days that expire on 1 July.
Sofie Janssens: Action (Jan): configure the reminder template in the absence module by 15 November 2026.
Sofie Janssens: Action (Sofie): inform Albert Heijn HR about the new reminder in the October account review.
